verdict.rationale: Honcho's changelog documents named-scope API keys: credentials bound to one named scope and limited to recall and message ingestion. That is a first-party least-privilege credential for agent use. The evidence is a single changelog line, so the issuance workflow and permission granularity are not shown. Missing for 10: documentation of how keys are issued (UI, CLI or API), finer-grained permission options beyond recall/ingestion, revocation and expiry controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Named-scope API keys: a key bound to one named scope, for recall and for message ingestion (including creating new member sessions).
